pattern.description: Both agent panes append their next step (left: a reasoning line about the MathPyramid component; right: a 'Good! Now let me check...' line and a new file-search step) and each stack jumps up inside its fixed pane in a few hard redraws.
pattern.why_premium: Continuous, independent progress in two panes under the line 'detect compiler errors and make fixes' sells autonomous parallel agents with zero added graphics; the pinned footers keep the composition stable while content flows.

build_hint.gsap: Per pane (overflow:hidden): gsap.to('.pane .stack', {y: '-=40', duration: 0.04, ease: 'steps(1)'}) repeated per appended row; gsap.fromTo('.pane .row:last-child', {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.03, ease: 'none'}, '<'); offset left vs right pane by 3-7 frames.
build_hint.remotion: Per pane: translateY steps by row height at each append frame (e.g. interpolate(frame, [t, t + 1], [y0, y0 - rowH], {extrapolateLeft: 'clamp', extrapolateRight: 'clamp'})); new row opacity = frame >= t ? 1 : 0. No spring.

notes: Four energy spikes (frames ~8, 11-12, 18) suggest at least three separate redraws across the two panes; mapping each spike to a pane is not possible from the filmstrip. Camera move is none.
